verdict.rationale: PII scrubbing is a fair question for an error-monitoring product, but the evidence pack never documents server-side scrubbing rules or SDK-level payload filtering. The nearby items cover different capabilities: data retention, person tracking, access tokens and offline payload storage. None of them scrubs sensitive fields before persistence.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can scrub PII from error events — server-side scrubbing rules plus SDK-level filtering — before sensitive payloads ever persist
